title: 9:16 vertical portrait, ultra-photoreali
prompt:
9:16 vertical portrait, ultra-photorealistic beauty photography, Korean-Japanese Y2K beauty editorial aesthetic.

A clearly adult East Asian woman, aged 23–27, with a small, delicate oval face, distinctly upturned cat-like eyes, and fair, luminous creamy skin with naturally preserved, realistic skin texture. Her overall appearance is refined, elegant, and effortlessly captivating.

Hairstyle: Black hair styled in a loose, low updo with wispy French bangs and delicate face-framing strands.

Makeup: Icy, translucent silver-pink eyeshadow, soft matte pink blush, clear glossy lips with a hydrated finish, delicate elongated cat-eye eyeliner, and long, naturally defined eyelashes.

Outfit & Accessories: A burgundy satin ribbon bow paired with a soft light-pink knitted cardigan, featuring delicate fabric textures and an effortlessly feminine aesthetic.

Pose & Expression: One fingertip gently touches the edge of her lower lip as she gazes lazily into the camera, with a subtly alluring, dreamy expression.

Setting: Beside a window in a vintage Tokyo café, surrounded by nostalgic Japanese interior details and soft natural daylight filtering through the glass.

Photography: 100mm extreme close-up macro beauty photography, exceptionally sharp eye details, delicate skin luminosity, subtle depth of field, and a refined editorial finish.

The composition frames her from the top of her head down to her chest, with her face as the primary visual focus, creating an intimate, sophisticated beauty magazine portrait.

Ultra-photorealistic, high resolution, realistic skin texture, natural anatomy, elegant color palette, delicate lighting, refined facial details, no text, no watermark.
